name: Brain Phase 2.0 Independent 150-Case Reasoning Benchmark
description: 150 unseen cases across 15 reasoning categories for separate Track A (Base Model) vs Track B (Brain System) evaluation.

cases.input: All nodes in cluster A are encrypted. Server 7 is in cluster A. Encrypted nodes require TLS. Does Server 7 require TLS? Answer Yes or No.
If a build fails, deployment stops. If deployment stops, alerts fire. The build failed. Did alerts fire? Answer Yes or No.
No offline service can reach external APIs. Service M is offline. Can Service M reach external APIs? Answer Yes or No.
Every cache miss triggers a DB read. A DB read adds 10ms. There were 3 cache misses. How many ms were added?
If P implies Q, and Q implies R, and R is false, is P true or false?
Alice finished before Bob. Bob finished before Carol. Who finished first?
Room 1 is larger than Room 2. Room 3 is smaller than Room 2. Which room is smallest?
All routers in Zone B use IPv6. Device K does not use IPv6. Is Device K in Zone B? Answer Yes or No.
A task needs 2 workers for 6 hours. With 3 workers at the same rate, how many hours does it take?

A train travels 180 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed in km/h?
If 5 notebooks cost 35 dollars, how much do 8 notebooks cost?
A tank holds 500 liters and is 40% full. How many liters are in the tank?

All triangles have 3 sides. Polygon P has 4 sides. Is P a triangle? Answer Yes or No.
Every Linux process has a PID. Bash is running as a Linux process. Does Bash have a PID? Answer Yes or No.
No read-only filesystem allows file creation. /mnt/ro is read-only. Can you create a file there? Answer Yes or No.
All birds have feathers. A penguin is a bird. Does a penguin have feathers? Answer Yes or No.
If a number ends in 0, it is divisible by 5. 40 ends in 0. Is 40 divisible by 5? Answer Yes or No.

If battery < 10%, enable power saver. Battery is 25%. Should power saver be enabled by this rule? Answer Yes or No.

If A AND B are true, return 1, else 0. A=True, B=False. What is returned?
